newsitem.title: POLAND: PRESIDENTIAL AIDE GETS POLISH DEFENCE POST.
newsitem.headline: PRESIDENTIAL AIDE GETS POLISH DEFENCE POST.

text.p: Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski will appoint his top aide Marek Siwiec on Wednesday as chief of the National Security Bureau, the presidential office dealing with defence, PAP news agency reported.

Siwiec, a former communist like the president, will fill the post vacant since the death last week of Jerzy Milewski, one of few former members of the pre-1989 Solidarity union who accepted high office from the ruling leftist coalition.
PAP quoted presidential spokesman Antoni Styrczula as saying that Siwiec, 41, would be nominated later on Wednesday.

Siwiec, now a minister in the presidential chancery, has been a parliamentary deputy of the co-ruling ex-communist Democratic Left Alliance and a member of the media watch-dog, the National Radio and Television Council. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
